answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 32308 Country: India Title: Bank Job Question: I would like to know that if i work in Investment Bank as a Secretary, does my job is Halal or Haram ? Answer ID: 32308 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 940/L=347/TL=1432) While doing the job of secretary in a bank if you have not to support in taking interest, giving interest, writing interest or bearing witness to it, then such a job is lawful. But if you have to support in giving interest, taking interest, writing interest or bearing witness to it, then such a job is not lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
